# Hack Nerd Font (bundled for deterministic PNG goldens)

`HackNerdFont-Regular.ttf` is the Hack typeface patched by the Nerd Fonts
project to add monospace icon glyphs. It is bundled into this test fixture
directory so `render_goldens::png_goldens_per_scene` can rasterize text
deterministically without depending on the host's installed font set.

## Sources

- Hack — https://github.com/source-foundry/Hack — MIT License
- Nerd Fonts patcher — https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts — MIT License
